# The PC110 board binding remains App-local.  Its real firmware is a BYOB
# build input; generated bytes stay in the build tree and never enter Git.
add_library(mypc110-board STATIC pc110_config.c pc110_display.c pc110_ec_block.c
    pc110_ec_mailbox.c
    pc110_firmware.c pc110_font.c pc110_lpt.c pc110_machine.c pc110_pcic.c pc110_plan.c)
target_include_directories(mypc110-board PUBLIC "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
target_link_libraries(mypc110-board PUBLIC types x86-core-machine x86-core-vl82c420
    x86-nxvm-machine
    x86-nxvm-board-base x86-nxvm-chip-f65535 x86-nxvm-chip-rb5c396)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    target_compile_options(mypc110-board PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endif()

function(mypc110_add_firmware_variant variant machine_key product_name bios_path bios_hash)
    nxvm_require_profile_asset("${bios_path}" 262144 "${bios_hash}")
    set(font_path "${machine_key}/firmware/pc110-kanji-font.rom")
    nxvm_require_profile_asset("${font_path}" 1048576
        "9829fdb8281c12022dc3b77686044ed1a5213ab526ce4329f2841cd64171784c")
    set(firmware_source "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/app-mypc110/${variant}_firmware.c")
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${firmware_source}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/app-mypc110"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
            "-DINPUT_BIOS_0=${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/${bios_path}"
            -DINPUT_BIOS_1=LIB_NULL -DINPUT_VIDEO=LIB_NULL -DINPUT_CMOS=LIB_NULL
            "-DINPUT_FONT=${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/${font_path}"
            "-DOUTPUT=${firmware_source}"
            -P "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/x86-nxvm/product/embed_firmware.cmake"
        DEPENDS
            "${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/${bios_path}"
            "${NXVM_PROFILE_ASSETS_ROOT}/${font_path}"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/x86-nxvm/product/embed_firmware.cmake"
        COMMENT "Embedding validated MyPC110 ${variant} firmware"
        VERBATIM)
    add_library(mypc110-real-firmware-${variant} STATIC EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
        "${firmware_source}")
    target_link_libraries(mypc110-real-firmware-${variant} PRIVATE types)
    target_include_directories(mypc110-real-firmware-${variant} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

    add_library(mypc110-product-${variant} STATIC product_binding.c)
    target_include_directories(mypc110-product-${variant} PUBLIC "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src"
        "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
    target_compile_definitions(mypc110-product-${variant} PRIVATE
        MYPC110_MACHINE_KEY="${machine_key}")
    target_link_libraries(mypc110-product-${variant} PUBLIC mypc110-board
        mypc110-real-firmware-${variant} x86-nxvm-product)
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(mypc110-product-${variant} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()

    # Preview binaries prove a fixed App entry and embedded BYOB inputs; they
    # are not deployed artifacts until guest qualification is complete.
    add_executable(mypc110-${variant}-preview EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL main.c)
    target_compile_definitions(mypc110-${variant}-preview PRIVATE
        MYPC110_PRODUCT_NAME="${product_name}")
    target_link_libraries(mypc110-${variant}-preview PRIVATE mypc110-product-${variant})
    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(mypc110-${variant}-preview PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    endif()
endfunction()

if(COMMAND nxvm_require_manifest)
    nxvm_require_manifest(ibm-pc110-tft)
    nxvm_require_manifest(ibm-pc110-dstn-derived)
    mypc110_add_firmware_variant(tft "ibm-pc110-tft" "MyPC110 TFT"
        "ibm-pc110-tft/firmware/pc110-tft-bios-1995-09-19.rom"
        "232101c88466f311bcc32fbc215a4d7569f695ce19f9c07ca67ce2aee5232312")
    mypc110_add_firmware_variant(dstn "ibm-pc110-dstn-derived" "MyPC110 DSTN"
        "ibm-pc110-dstn-derived/firmware/pc110-dstn-derived-2026-07-27.rom"
        "aa2ab27a8cc4fee059238fdbd4bd869f209f5f1c3a67096fc8704ca795857121")
endif()
